Downtown & Mile Square.name: Downtown & Mile Square
Downtown & Mile Square.description: Central business and Mile Square core with the Monon/East Street corridors, office-to-residential conversions, and statehouse/civic demand.

Mass Ave & Chatham Arch.name: Mass Ave & Chatham Arch
Mass Ave & Chatham Arch.description: Massachusetts Avenue arts, dining, and theater district with brick rowhouse conversion and boutique hospitality demand.

Fountain Square & Fletcher Place.name: Fountain Square & Fletcher Place
Fountain Square & Fletcher Place.description: South-side historic commercial node on the Cultural Trail with Victorian infill, brewery-led adaptive reuse, and neighborhood retail.

Broad Ripple.name: Broad Ripple
Broad Ripple.description: North-side riverside village with a dense entertainment strip, canal-front retail, and steady single-family and small-multifamily renovation.

Irvington.name: Irvington
Irvington.description: Historic east-side National Register district along Washington Street with craftsman stock, commercial-corridor reinvestment, and infill housing.
